fix.delta: Add structured output wrapper with JSONL fallback parser for sov6-logic-v3-light models. The current prompt format produces unparseable output (33/33 cards fail parsing). The fix adds: (1) explicit JSONL output schema instruction in system prompt, (2) a best-effort fallback parser that extracts label/confidence from free-text when structured parse fails, (3) a transport-time retry with temperature reduction (t=0.3→t=0.1) on parse failure. This should recover ~15-20 of 33 currently-zero cards without changing the semantic evaluation rubric.
